mapper.sql: select o.offering_id, o.course_id, o.term_id, o.teacher_id, o.capacity, o.enrolled_count, o.schedule_text, o.status, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, c.code as course_code, c.title_zh as course_title, c.credits as units, c.category as course_category, t.term_code, t.term_name, te.name as teacher_name from edu_course_offering o left join edu_course c on c.course_id = o.course_id left join edu_term t on t.term_id = o.term_id left join edu_teacher te on te.teacher_id = o.teacher_id

select o.offering_id, o.course_id, o.term_id, o.teacher_id, o.capacity, (select count(1) from edu_enrollment en where en.offering_id = o.offering_id and en.status = 'ENROLLED') as enrolled_count, (select count(1) from edu_assignment a where a.offering_id = o.offering_id and a.del_flag = '0') as assignment_count, o.schedule_text, o.status, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, c.code as course_code, c.title_zh as course_title, c.credits as units, c.category as course_category, t.term_code, t.term_name, te.name as teacher_name from edu_course_offering o left join edu_course c on c.course_id = o.course_id left join edu_term t on t.term_id = o.term_id left join edu_teacher te on te.teacher_id = o.teacher_id
mapper.select: where o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by t.term_code desc, c.code asc
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_offering ( course_id, term_id, teacher_id, capacity, enrolled_count, schedule_text, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{courseId}, #{termId}, #{teacherId}, #{capacity}, #{enrolledCount}, #{scheduleText}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from edu_course_offering where offering_id in
#{offeringId}
